cases.agentStoppedBare: The agent stopped on its own after 3 step(s) without reaching https://x.test/end and without naming anything that blocked it.
cases.apiError: The crawl could not run: Failed to fetch (after 4 agent step(s)). This is a Selenite or API failure, not a finding about the site.
cases.attachFailed: The crawl could not run: Could not attach for crawl (is DevTools open?): boom. This is a Selenite or API failure, not a finding about the site.
cases.coordSpace: Ended early after 3 step(s): the screenshot and the page's viewport stopped agreeing on size, so the agent's coordinates could not be converted into click points and nothing was dispatched. This is a Selenite failure, not a finding about the site.
cases.empty: Did not reach undefined after 0 agent step(s); no cause could be determined from the recorded evidence.
cases.exception: The crawl could not run: x is not defined (after 1 agent step(s)). This is a Selenite or API failure, not a finding about the site.
cases.gateCaptcha: The agent stopped after 3 step(s) and reported a CAPTCHA / bot check, which it is instructed not to attempt (matched "reCAPTCHA"). In its own words: "A reCAPTCHA blocks the path, so I am stopping here."
cases.gateLogin: The agent stopped after 3 step(s) and reported a login or authentication wall, which it is instructed not to attempt (matched "login wall"). In its own words: "This needs a login wall to be passed, which I will not attempt."
cases.gatePayment: The agent stopped after 3 step(s) and reported a step that would move real money, which it is instructed not to attempt (matched "place the order"). In its own words: "The next step is to place the order, which would be a real transaction."
cases.legacyBudget: Ran out of budget after 10 step(s) without reaching https://x.test/end; the page was still changing, so raising the step budget may get further.
cases.maxTokens: The agent's reply was cut off by the token limit on step 2 before it issued an action, so the crawl stalled on a tooling limit rather than on anything about the site. Re-run.
cases.modelTimeout: The model did not answer within the time allowed on step 3, so the crawl stopped with the page untouched. This is an API or network failure, not a finding about the site. Re-run.
cases.noReason: Did not reach https://x.test/end after 2 agent step(s); no cause could be determined from the recorded evidence.
cases.noop: 3 of 3 steps used "hover", which this crawler does not dispatch, so the page was never given anything to respond to. This is a Selenite gap, not a site issue.
cases.notAttempted: Not attempted — the crawl had already stopped at an earlier segment.
cases.offViewport: 4 of 4 actions used coordinates outside the 1000x800 viewport and were never dispatched, so nothing could respond.
cases.refusal: The model declined to continue on step 2: "I cannot continue with this."
cases.runaway: Stopped after 500 agent step(s) without reaching https://x.test/end, on an internal safety limit. Nothing ended the segment on its own first — not the clock, not the no-progress check, not arrival — so a guard that should have caught this did not. This is a Selenite failure, not a finding about the site.
cases.stuckDelivered: 6 consecutive clicks were delivered to #cta and the page did not change: same URL, same title, same visible text, and no DOM mutation. The click reached an element, so this is not a targeting problem — but this check cannot confirm which control the agent meant to hit, so treat it as an observation to reproduce by hand rather than a proven site defect.
cases.stuckDisabled: 6 consecutive clicks landed on #go, which is disabled, so the page ignored them. Something earlier in the flow has probably not validated yet.
cases.stuckIframe: 6 consecutive clicks landed on an embedded frame, whose contents this tool cannot see into or drive, so what happened inside it is unknown. The page's URL, title and visible text were unchanged after each, and no DOM change was observed.
cases.stuckIntercept: 6 consecutive clicks were landing on the OneTrust cookie-consent banner (#onetrust-banner-sdk), covering 40% of the viewport, rather than on the intended control. The page's URL, title and visible text were unchanged after each, and no DOM change was observed.
cases.stuckNotDelivered: 6 consecutive clicks were dispatched on #cta but no element received a click event, so the page never saw them.
cases.stuckNothing: 6 consecutive clicks landed on no element at all — there is nothing at that point on the page. The page's URL, title and visible text were unchanged after each, and no DOM change was observed.
cases.stuckOwnDismiss: 6 consecutive clicks were delivered to #onetrust-banner-sdk and the page did not change: same URL, same title, same visible text, and no DOM mutation. The click reached an element, so this is not a targeting problem — but this check cannot confirm which control the agent meant to hit, so treat it as an observation to reproduce by hand rather than a proven site defect.
cases.stuckReason: Ended early after 6 step(s): the agent repeated an action that provably changed nothing, and the rest of the budget would not have changed that.
cases.stuckUnknown: 6 consecutive clicks changed nothing on #cta, and this check could not confirm whether they were delivered, so the cause is unresolved.
cases.timeout: Ran out of time after 300s and 5 agent step(s) without reaching https://x.test/end. 200s of that was spent waiting for the model and 10s on the page. Nothing here says the page is broken — this hop simply takes longer than the time allowed for it.
cases.timeoutNoTimes: Ran out of time after 0s and 5 agent step(s) without reaching https://x.test/end. Nothing here says the page is broken — this hop simply takes longer than the time allowed for it.
cases.unconverted: 4 of 4 actions used a coordinate that could not be converted out of the screenshot's pixel space — the screenshot is 1000x800 against a 1000x800 viewport, which scale by 1.000 across and 1.000 down. Where those clicks would have landed is unknown, so nothing measured after them describes the site. This is a Selenite coordinate-space failure, not a finding about the page.
cases.unknownReason: Did not reach https://x.test/end after 2 agent step(s); no cause could be determined from the recorded evidence.
cases.userStopped: Stopped by the tester after 2 agent step(s) — no verdict for this segment.
